Test fixtures: a cut of the FAA NASR CSV and CIFP data for cycle 2026-10-29 (FAA data, public domain).

nasr/   rows of the NASR CSV files, unchanged, for: the ZAU boundary (ARB_BASE, ARB_SEG);
        airports ORD, MDW, JFK (APT_BASE, APT_RWY_END, CLS_ARSP); STARs BENKY, ENDEE, CAMRN;
        DPs O'HARE and MIDWAY (radar-vector, no coded route); airways V156 and V227; and the
        FIX_BASE / NAV_BASE rows those reference. The *_CSV_DATA_STRUCTURE files are whole.
        PFR_BASE.csv and PFR_SEG.csv are header-only synthetic empty files for parser/build
        coverage; they do not contain or represent FAA preferred-route records.
cifp/   FAACIFP18 records, unchanged, for: KORD, KMDW, KJFK airport, runway, localizer and
        terminal waypoint records; KORD STAR BENKY6, approach I09L; KMDW STAR ENDEE8, approach
        I04R; KJFK STAR CAMRN5; KORD class B airspace; a few MOA records (outside ZAU); four Grid MORA rows; the enroute waypoints and navaids those reference.
        Only the declared record count in the header (HDR01, columns 29-35) was changed, to the
        number of records kept, because the parser checks it.

Tests edit copies of these files in memory (moving a fix, deleting a row) to inject faults.
